title: French Peruvian Wrap with Zesty Potato Filling
description: A fusion of French flavors with Peruvian spices in a crispy wrap. The zesty potato filling is the perfect accompaniment to a busy French day.
instructions: Boil the diced potatoes until tender.
In a pan, heat the zesty sauce over medium heat.
Add the boiled potatoes to the pan and stir well.
In a separate pan, warm the Peruvian wrap according to package instructions.
Spoon the potato mixture onto the wrap.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese and chopped cilantro if desired.
Fold the wrap to enclose the filling.
